findings.detail: Commit eacb6ff adds docs/problems/CONCURRENT_WRITERS.md as a new file (+347 lines). Diff inspection confirms line 157 reads 'each blake3 hash = 64 hex chars' and line 217 reads 'commits `blake3(canonical CBOR bytes)` to Solana' — both byte-identical to the After: strings in §4.5. Source-of-truth check: recovered/problems/CONCURRENT_WRITERS.md line 157/217 contain the documented Before: strings (SHA3-256 hash and SHA3-256(encrypted_blob)) verbatim, confirming the replacement was applied during copy and nothing else was altered around those lines.

Re-ran the broader regression `grep -RIE 'SHA3|Pre-V1|pre-V1' docs/problems/` (superset of the requested check). Exit code 1, zero hits. The narrower 'SHA3' grep also returns empty. Confirms both token replacements were applied and no stale tokens remain in any of the 4 files (MEMORY_EVICTION, CONCURRENT_WRITERS, ARWEAVE_PRICING_VALIDATION, README).

findings.check: future agent can reproduce the edits from documentation alone
findings.detail: §4.5 provides: (a) exact line numbers (157, 217), (b) full Before: string with surrounding context, (c) full After: string with surrounding context, (d) the source-of-truth path (recovered/problems/CONCURRENT_WRITERS.md), (e) the destination path (docs/problems/CONCURRENT_WRITERS.md), (f) the verify-smoke command and its expected output. Combined with §4.3 row-level rationale ('both produce 32-byte / 64-hex-char outputs, table sizing preserved' for line 157; 'aligns with shipped data-flow per architecture.md' for line 217), the audit trail is fully self-describing. Reproduction recipe: copy recovered/problems/CONCURRENT_WRITERS.md to docs/problems/, then sed -i 's/SHA3-256 hash = 64 hex/blake3 hash = 64 hex/' on line 157 and 's/SHA3-256(encrypted_blob)/blake3(canonical CBOR bytes)/' on line 217.
